record.paper_title: Some Open Questions in Quiver Gauge Theory
record.original_question: Can one establish a complete correspondence between tropical geometry and neural networks, especially the piecewise-linear functions arising from ReLU architectures?

evidence.quote: Question 31. Can we establish a complete correspondence between tropical geometry and neural networks?

artifact.status_search_result: Substantial progress has been made. Zhang–Naitzat–Lim (2018) showed that feedforward ReLU networks with integer weights are equivalent to tropical rational maps, relating linear regions to vertices of Newton polytopes and decision boundaries to tropical hypersurfaces. Subsequent work (e.g., Brandenburg–Loho–Montúfar, 2024, "The Real Tropical Geometry of Neural Networks") extends this to real weights via real tropical geometry, embedding the parameter space of ReLU networks as a semialgebraic subset of tropical rational function space. A fully complete dictionary including all architectural and geometric invariants is still being developed, so the problem is partially solved.

status_evidence.title: Tropical Geometry of Deep Neural Networks
status_evidence.snippet: Every feedforward neural network with ReLU activation is a tropical rational map; linear regions correspond to vertices of associated polytopes.
status_evidence.claim: Establishes the foundational correspondence for integer-weight ReLU networks.

status_evidence.title: The Real Tropical Geometry of Neural Networks
status_evidence.snippet: The parameter space of ReLU networks is a semialgebraic set inside the parameter space of tropical rational functions.
status_evidence.claim: Extends the correspondence to real weights via real tropical geometry.
